a: वत् — a. 1 An affix added to nouns to show ‘possession’; धनवत् possessed of wealth; रूपवत् beautiful; so भगवत्, भास्वत् &c.; (the words so formed being adjectives). --2 Added to the base of the past passive participle वत् turns it into a past active participle; इत्युक्तवंतं जनकात्मजायां R. 14. 43. --ind. An affix added to nouns or adjectives to denote ‘likeness’ or ‘resemblance’ and may be translated by ‘like’, ‘as’; आत्मवत्सर्वभूतानि यः पश्यति स पंडितः.
